qualification_harness.cmake_source:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(FilesLocationValues LANGUAGES CXX)
file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${SOURCE}" SOURCE)
file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${SDK}" SDK)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
include("${SOURCE}/cmake/CkToolsStrict.cmake")
if(MSVC)
 set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY MultiThreaded)
 add_compile_options(/fsanitize=address)
 add_link_options(/DEBUG /INCREMENTAL:NO)
else()
 add_compile_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
 add_link_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()
add_subdirectory("${SOURCE}/src/native-core/files" core)
add_executable(location_values
 "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files/files_completion_index.cpp"
 "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files/tests/files_completion_index_tests.cpp"
 "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files/files_location.cpp"
 "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files/files_location_text.cpp"
 "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files/files_location_draft.cpp"
 "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files/tests/files_location_text_tests.cpp"
 "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files/tests/files_location_draft_tests.cpp"
 "${SOURCE}/src/vision/host/cktest_main.cpp"
)
target_include_directories(location_values PRIVATE "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files" "${SOURCE}/src/native-core/files" "${SDK}/include")
target_link_libraries(location_values PRIVATE ck_files_platform)
target_include_directories(location_values PRIVATE "${SOURCE}/tests/support")
target_compile_definitions(location_values PRIVATE CKTOOLS_TEST_TEMP_ROOT="${FIXTURES}" CKTOOLS_FILES_PRIVATE_INDEX_TEST_ROOT="${PRIVATE_FIXTURES}")
cktools_strict(location_values)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME location_values COMMAND location_values)
set_tests_properties(location_values PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60)
qualification_harness.scope: UI-free completion index matcher, codec and draft plus all native-core/platform dependencies and all 41 cases. Every unit instrumented. Real native directory/private-index test included. No ckVision UI binary is linked; no service-thread, mailbox, UI-controller race or actual-window qualification claimed.

timing_and_freshness.scope: Initial normal build compiles ten units and links twice; final page-completeness/coverage refinement compiles two units and links twice. Prior query build compiled eight units in 15.592 seconds; current initial build 14.527 seconds. Actual flags, input/object/output hashes and case sets establish freshness. The new full native-dependency matcher harness supersedes the prior ten-unit value harness; their durations are not presented as like-for-like baselines. Prior fresh builds of the same 68-unit matcher harness before the final eligibility-policy refinement are retained below as comparable timing baselines. Final runs freshly compile all units; no obsolete object/cache reuse is accepted. No new thread/mailbox/UI/SDK binary code changed.

review.semantics: Canonical native prefix interval, directories only, bounded sequential reads/output, explicit uncertainty and proposal failures. Immutable owner-free continuations bind exact query/dataset/scan/hidden policy. Last resumed page remains a subset; partial results never establish uniqueness.
review.limits: At most one bounded page read/scan per advance and 64 emitted candidates. Native/text/per-candidate quotas are independent; first-row budget failure is explicit. No native re-enumeration, new sort, RAM source copy, source mutation or fallback. Source-parent binding remains the composition root responsibility.
review.cases: Thirteen new cases cover real native/private index use, exact raw POSIX/UTF-16 names, directory/link classification, uncertainty, row/native/text pagination, same-batch replay, moved/foreign/changed continuations, source reuse after cancellation, real error precedence, exceptions, teardown, invalid limits and 1025-row linear bounded paging.
review.refinement: Before final qualification, resumed-page completeness was tightened to carry has_previous even at exhaustion; final-page size cannot masquerade as whole-query uniqueness. Moved-token, additional invalid-limit and pending-abandonment coverage was added. No failed build or test was used to qualify final source.
review.remaining: WP-02 remains open for native-parent discovery/cache ownership, asynchronous latest-query/revision/lifetime gating and ckVision provider/Right-to-accept integration, then histories/bookmarks, qualified refresh, properties/preview and production executable/interactive acceptance.

repair.reason: Failed fixture path macro quoting; no product source changed

excluded_harness_failure.reason: Windows-only diagnostic driver passed backslashes into C++ fixture string macros, causing C4129/C2220. Driver now supplies forward-slash CMake paths. Failed tree was retired after exact owner check; final Windows qualification freshly rebuilt all 68 units. Product source was unchanged by this harness correction.

final_policy_refinement: Per-candidate text eligibility must match across continuation pages. Its changed-limit case was added before final qualification; aggregate output page bounds remain adjustable. Prior sanitizer/normal results are timing evidence only, superseded for final source by fresh final runs.
